title: Agentic AI orchestration pipeline for rapid analysis of chokepoint crises (Strait of Hormuz 2026 case)
description: LangGraph-based orchestration of a multi-model, multi-scenario analytical pipeline for chokepoint crises. The release used for the revised Communications Engineering manuscript includes the domain-model adapters and analytical reductions, the upstream-to-downstream forwarding mechanism, the synthesis fidelity audit, the per-cell coverage ledger, the run-specific model inventory, and the deterministic analyst baseline (configs/baselines/hormuz_2026_analyst.yaml) used as the comparator for the LLM-driven path. Given names and ORCIDs of the co-authors are to be completed by the authors before publishing the record.
notes: Companion software for the manuscript 'Agentic AI Modeling for Rapid Analysis of Chokepoint Crises Along Strategic and Economic Dimensions: A Case Study of the Closure of the Strait of Hormuz' (Communications Engineering, manuscript 28847ff1). Vendored upstream models under Models/ keep their own licenses; see docs/revision/model_licenses.md.
